claims.claim: Bent office chair available for sale
claims.evidence: Photo shows chair reclined almost flat, which matches normal recline function, but 'bent' could also mean a bent/damaged frame or stuck mechanism; the report does not confirm which, and no close-up of the frame joints or recline lever operation is available.
No geolocation or address proof in the photo; location claims cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: 'Bent' may indicate a structurally damaged or permanently stuck frame rather than a normal recline feature
risks.proof: A clip showing the seller moving the recline lever and the chair returning upright, plus a close-up of the frame joints/hinges
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-functional/damaged recline mechanism (worst case)

risks.risk: Caster wheels may be worn, cracked, or not rolling smoothly
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of all five wheels rolling on a hard floor

risks.risk: Height-adjustment gas lift may be weak, sinking, or non-functional
risks.proof: Video of seat height lever being used with a person sitting, showing it holds height

risks.risk: Mesh back may have tears, stains, or sagging not visible from the shown angle
risks.proof: Clear photos of the full back and underside of the mesh in good light

risks.risk: Armrests or headrest pad may be loose, cracked, or detached under use
risks.proof: Video of someone pressing down on armrests and headrest to show no wobble
risks.if_unproven: priced as loose/unstable armrests and headrest

risks.risk: Unknown age and usage history affecting overall wear
risks.proof: Any purchase receipt, warranty card, or seller statement on age (data only, not proof)

proof_requests: Video of the recline lever being operated, showing the chair moving from flat to upright and back
Close-up photos of all caster wheels rolling on a hard floor
Video demonstrating the height-adjustment lever holding position under weight
Full clear photos of the back and underside of the mesh fabric
Video of pressure test on armrests and headrest for stability
Any close-up of frame joints/welds to clarify what 'bent' refers to
response.reason: The item type (reclining mesh office chair) is confirmed by the witness, so it can be priced at worst case given the ambiguous 'bent' claim and multiple unverified mechanical risks, pending the listed proofs to raise the price.
